name: Sofia Nair
headline: Junior Platform Engineer
summary: Junior platform engineer focused on keeping internal systems reliable, secure, and easy to operate. Comfortable working across container setup, access control, monitoring, and automation. Known for clear handoffs, steady follow-through, and practical improvements to day-to-day operations.

roles.title: Junior Platform Engineer
bullets: Automated setup tasks with Bash and Docker, reducing new environment preparation time by 40% for the support team.
Maintained access policies in IAM and reviewed account requests, cutting manual approval delays by 25%.
Built monitoring views in Grafana to surface service health trends and helped the team resolve issues before they spread.
Packaged repeatable platform tasks into simple runbooks, improving on-call response consistency across 3 shifts.

projects.name: Tidal Inbox
projects.description: Set up automated checks with GitHub Actions and Prometheus to track delivery status and alert the team when message processing drifted.

projects.name: Lantern Dashboard
projects.description: Shaped the access flow in IAM so reviewers could grant and revoke permissions with fewer manual steps.

projects.name: Quiet Pipeline
